gap_notes: CORE cannot be scored: geometry and harmonious/discordant labels are from Ptolemy I.16 (conjunction from I.27). Lilly's chapter of terms/aspects (CA ~p.105) is not opened this pass — listed pending, not backfilled.
Ptolemy I.16 names opposition, trine, quartile, sextile. Conjunction is bodily application in I.27, not a sign-configuration in I.16.

Ptolemy's only qualitative split is harmonious (trine, sextile: same sex) vs discordant (quartile, opposition: different sex). Schema interaction enum is finer. Mapping is the thinnest fit; do not add modern 'growth edge' or 'opportunity mindset'.

requires_action is boolean in schema (no unknown/not_evidenced). false here means the opened locus does not establish the property — not the assertion 'this aspect does not require action'. Do not copy the Layer 4 table ('square requires action') into the object without a locus. Schema not expanded.
